name: Glomerular Filtration Rate (24h Creatinine Clearance, Ccr)

map.🫘 肾小球滤过率（24h 肌酐清除 Ccr）: 🫘 Glomerular Filtration Rate (24h Creatinine Clearance Ccr)
map.根据 24 小时尿肌酐浓度、尿量与血肌酐计算内生肌酐清除率（Ccr），并按体表面: Compute endogenous creatinine clearance (Ccr) from 24-hour urine creatinine concentration, urine volume and serum creatinine, corrected by body surface area (BSA).
map.⚠️ 本工具仅为肾功能估算与教学辅助，不构成肾脏诊断依据。请结合医生评估与检验结: ⚠️ This tool is only for kidney function estimation and teaching assistance, and does not constitute a basis for kidney diagnosis. Decide staging and treatment in combination with physician assessment and test results.
map.Ccr (mL/min) = (尿肌酐浓度 × 24h尿量) ÷ (血肌酐浓度: Ccr (mL/min) = (urine creatinine concentration × 24h urine volume) ÷ (serum creatinine concentration × 1440)
map.单位换算：血肌酐 1 mg/dL = 88.4 μmol/L；尿肌酐 1 mg/: Unit conversion: serum creatinine 1 mg/dL = 88.4 μmol/L; urine creatinine 1 mg/dL = 0.0884 mmol/L (i.e. 1 mmol/L = 11.3 mg/dL)
map.正常参考：成人约 80-120 mL/min，女性略低，随年龄每 10 年下降约: Normal reference: adults about 80-120 mL/min, slightly lower in women, declining about 6.5 mL/min per decade of age.
map.⚠️ 需准确收集 24h 尿液，肉食摄入、剧烈运动会影响结果。严重肾功能不全时: ⚠️ Accurate 24h urine collection is required; meat intake and strenuous exercise affect the result. In severe renal insufficiency Ccr overestimates GFR.
map.CG=((140−age)×kg)/(72×Scr)，女×0.85；粗略估剂量但: CG=((140−age)×kg)/(72×Scr), ×0.85 for women; rough dose estimate but biased high.
map.与肌酐清除区别？: What is the difference from creatinine clearance?
map.本工具同时给 Ccr 与 Cockcroft-Gault，后者常用于药量调整。: This tool gives both Ccr and Cockcroft-Gault, the latter commonly used for dose adjustment.
map.Ccr×(1.73/BSA) 消除体型影响，标准: Ccr×(1.73/BSA) removes body size effect, standard.
